# Lamp Builder 1.2.2
- Restored the house symbol on the Home toolbar button.
- Live balance details now appear automatically at the top left of the 3D canvas for table and floor lamps. No status-bar click is needed. - Tipping risk has a prominent red heading and border, with its animated cue, footprint diagram, estimated margin, mass and corrective suggestions visible in the panel. - Quick Connect and cord-placement options appear beside the balance panel when space allows; narrow windows stack the cards with scrolling. - X-ray controls move to the lower right to keep the top-left panel clear. - Corrected the Quick Connect elbow description to say Turn 90 degrees; assembly rotation remains in 45-degree steps.
Balance remains an estimate based on the recorded parts and loads, not a certification of structural safety.
